name: imri-plugins

categories.label: Connectors
categories.description: Plugins and skills that put a connected app's own UI in the chat.

categories.label: Product demos
categories.description: Recordings and walkthroughs that show a product in use.

categories.label: Design assets
categories.description: Create and revise visual assets, mascot illustrations and emoji.

skills.name: product-preview
skills.description: Record a short, captioned GIF of a real product flow, a matched before/after comparison, or a feature walkthrough. Includes a portable Chromium/CDP recorder, GIF encoder, review images, and optional presentation-page and cover templates. Use when asked to make a product preview, demo recording, or feature GIF. Not for implementing the feature, fabricated UI animations, static mockups, or posting the result.
skills.creator: Imri Sofer

skills.name: ship-app-cards
skills.description: Take a connected app from no App Cards to shipped, end to end: learn the card rules, agree which of the app's screens become cards, build them in the app's bundled Bonsai plugin, run up to three eval + UX-expert rounds until each card feels like the real app, record previews and add the app to the launch kit, then merge and announce. Use when someone asks to set up, add or build App Cards (chat cards that look and work like the app) for a service such as Gmail, Todoist, Notion or GitHub, or to run the whole card process for an app. Needs a top model and the yaklabs-ai/kay repo. Not for fixing one card's bug, showing an app's records with cards that already exist, the card visual rules alone, or a launch page with no new cards.
skills.creator: Imri Sofer

skills.name: yakomoji
skills.description: Create or revise consistent Yako (Yucko) mascot emoji as transparent still PNGs or looping animated GIFs, using the bundled character reference and the team's established cartoon style.
skills.creator: Imri Sofer
